# Overview

**Feature:** `002-acos-property-search` — the `acos-property-search` skill.
**Generated by:** `/preeng.specify` (acos-preeng-classic deterministic worker).
**Authoritative input:** `.claude/skills/acos-property-search/PLAN.md` (already-completed product
context + research + plan; treated as authoritative).

A **project skill** (`disable-model-invocation: true`, `user-invocable: true`) that, given **either
a person name or a business/entity name** (+ optional anchors: city/state, company, known address,
phone), casts the widest defensible net to find all US real property the party **owns or controls**,
nationwide, for **skip-tracing / collections**. It returns ranked, deduplicated, provenance-tagged
holdings in confidence tiers, with an estimated equity picture, a compliance record, and an audit
trail — using **free / open-web sources only** (no paid APIs).

**Headline principle (adopted verbatim from PLAN.md):** *Don't search for "who owns this property" —
search for "what assets are likely controlled by this economic actor."*

**Form factor:** methodology (`SKILL.md`) + small **stdlib-only** Python helpers + reference files.
No external infrastructure (no Neo4j / Elasticsearch / Postgres / billing). Lives at
`.claude/skills/acos-property-search/`, versioned with the project.

> **Assumption (worker default):** No `feature_config.json` was provided to the worker. All config-shaped
> facts below are lifted from PLAN.md and the vision context; primary user inferred as **Zee /
> OKOA Capital** (collections/asset-recovery context). Marked `Assumption` where inferred.

## Diagnostics

> Protocol 0.3 (problem-before-solution). Diagnosis is referenced by `## Requirements` and by the
> diagnostic slice `slice-00-diagnostic`. Incomplete-diagnosis items are carried as `Assumption` with a
> validation slice attached.

### Symptoms (what is going wrong today)
- **No free nationwide owner-name property search exists.** Ownership lives across ~3,100 counties under
  48+ recording statutes; a single owner-name lookup misses most of the portfolio.
- **Concealment defeats naive search:** property is held under LLCs, land trusts, nominees, series LLCs,
  contract-for-deed, life estates, and TIC, so a direct owner-name assessor query returns almost nothing
  for a sophisticated actor.
- **Name-blocked jurisdictions** (CA Gov. Code §7928.205, Cook County IL, NJ Daniel's Law) suppress
  owner names entirely, breaking the obvious channel.
- **Paid aggregators are off-limits** (cost + FCRA/data-broker exposure), so commercial owner-search is
  not an option.
- **Compliance risk is real and asymmetric:** skip-tracing carries DPPA / FCRA / FDCPA / GLBA exposure;
  an uncontrolled search can create legal liability.

### Affected roles / personas
- **Collections / asset-recovery analyst (primary — Assumption: Zee at OKOA Capital):** needs the widest
  defensible asset picture on a judgment debtor or borrower.
- **Reviewing counsel / compliance (gatekeeper):** must confirm permissible purpose before any search.
- **Downstream consumer (v2):** the loan-doc renderer that turns findings into an institutional memo.

### Current vs. desired behavior
- **Current:** ad-hoc, single-channel owner-name searches that miss controlled entities, mis-attribute
  common-name hits, harmonize conflicts silently, and carry no compliance record or audit trail.
- **Desired:** a multi-channel union (9 discovery channels) with an entity graph, hub-guarded expansion,
  a scoring rubric with confidence tiers, preserved conflicts as manual-review flags, an estimated equity
  rollup, hedged language, a blocking compliance gate, and a full provenance audit trail.

### Hypotheses
- **H1 (completeness):** "Widest net" = maximizing the number of independent discovery channels and
  pivots, then taking the **union** — not finding one magic search. *(Drives the 9-channel architecture.)*
- **H2 (corroboration):** Because each channel-agent works **blind** to the others, two agents
  independently landing on the same parcel is *genuine* corroboration — which is what makes
  "Verified = 2+ independent sources" non-circular. *(Drives swarm isolation + the synthesizer.)*
- **H3 (precision):** Without a hub stop-list + hop limit + inverse-frequency weighting, a hub registered
  agent / shared address explodes the graph (N² false links). *(Drives the hub-guard.)*

### Unknowns (open; routed to diagnostic slice / Open Questions)
- Exact per-portal availability / 403-block behavior of each free source (varies; degrades over time).
- Real-world false-positive rate of the scoring rubric at the 75 / 50 cutoffs (tunable; needs a dry run).
- Whether the embedded swarm (D1) vs. composing `acos-swarm-research` (D1-alt) is the better wiring at
  scale. *(PLAN.md Decision D1 default = embed; carried.)*

## Users & Use Cases

### Primary users
- **Collections / asset-recovery analyst** (Assumption: Zee, OKOA Capital). Technical, Claude Code power
  user. Runs the skill explicitly on a named judgment debtor or defaulted borrower.

### Representative use cases
1. **Person → portfolio.** "Find all US real property likely controlled by *Michael Johnson, Tampa,
   associated with Apex Storage*." Expects ranked tiers + equity rollup + audit trail.
2. **Entity → portfolio.** "Find all property controlled by *Apex Storage Holdings LLC* and its
   affiliates." Expects entity-graph expansion (officers/agents/siblings) + parcels.
3. **Concealment piercing.** Subject holds via a land trust / nominee / series LLC; expects channel-9
   piercing (mortgage signatories, guaranty, UCC debtor name, tax-bill mailing address triangulation).
4. **Refresh / monitoring (v2).** Re-run a subject periodically and **alert on new acquisitions /
   transfers** (recorder index updates in days; assessor lags).
5. **Institutional deliverable (v2).** Hand structured findings to the loan-doc renderer for a
   screenshot-verified underwriting-style memo.

## Requirements

### 4.1 Functional Requirements (MoSCoW)

**Must (MVP / v1):**
- **M1 — Compliance gate (BLOCKING, runs first, every time).** Refuse to proceed until a
  permissible-purpose record is captured (DPPA §2721(b)(3)/(b)(4); FCRA §1681b; debt classification
  consumer vs. commercial; GLBA anti-pretexting hard block; scraping posture). Per-run record schema per
  `references/compliance.md`.
- **M2 — Normalize / classify input.** Person vs. entity; alias / maiden / Jr-Sr / middle-name variants;
  fuzzy match. (`scripts/normalize.py`.)
- **M3 — Stage 1 identity resolution.** Aliases, prior addresses, spouse/relatives/associates
  (free people-search — **leads only**, corroborate before scoring). Require ≥2 anchors for common names.
- **M4 — Entity graph engine.** Nodes/edges with **temporal + provenance** on every edge
  (`{source, source_url, confidence, date_first_seen, date_last_verified, effective_date,
  expiration_date, raw_evidence}`); edge types + edge-strength ordering per PLAN.md §4.
- **M5 — Hub guards (precision).** Registered-agent stop-list (`references/hub_agents.txt`), dynamic hub
  detection (default threshold **25**), bounded hops (default **2 degrees**), inverse-frequency
  weighting, **log every prune**.
- **M6 — Discovery channels 1–4 + recorder index (v1 core):** assessor owner-name search (free states),
  recorder grantor-grantee index, mailing-address pivot (ArcGIS REST `MAIL_ADDR LIKE` / bulk-roll
  group-by), entity graph (SoS + OpenCorporates).
- **M7 — Embedded swarm + between-rounds synthesizer.** Loop-until-dry, hop-limited; fan-out isolated
  parallel agents per channel×jurisdiction×entity; synthesizer cross-references → confidence, **preserves
  conflicts** as review flags, **hub-prunes + enforces the hop limit**, emits next-round seeds; stop when
  a round yields no new high-confidence nodes.
- **M8 — Dedup on APN** + per-owner aggregation (`scripts/dedup.py`).
- **M9 — Scoring + tiers + review flags.** Merged scoring rubric (PLAN.md §7), tiers **≥75 high /
  50–74 candidate / <50 weak**, manual-review flag taxonomy. (`scripts/score.py`.)
- **M10 — Equity / value / debt rollup** from FREE data; every figure labeled "estimated"
  (`scripts/rollup.py`).
- **M11 — Output: single Markdown report** (compliance header → tiers → per-parcel evidence chain →
  estimated portfolio equity → coverage/limits footer → review flags) with **mandated hedged language**.
- **M12 — Cache layer** wrapping every external lookup, JSON, freshness TTLs (`scripts/cache.py`);
  per-record freshness stamps surface in the report.
- **M13 — Audit trail.** `workspace/<session-id>/round-NN/agent-NN/findings.md` + `synthesis/`.
- **M14 — Unit tests** for the deterministic scripts (normalize/score/dedup/rollup) via the `testing` skill.

**Should (v2):**
- **S1 — Channels 5–6:** UCC fixture filings, abstracts of judgment / mechanics / tax liens / lis
  pendens, bankruptcy Schedule A/B + SOFA (PACER/RECAP).
- **S2 — Concealment-piercing playbook (channel 9)** at depth.
- **S3 — Institutional render** via `acos-loan-doc-generator-with-visual-verification`.
- **S4 — Monitoring** via `/schedule` (cron cloud agent) + new-acquisition/transfer alerts off cache
  freshness deltas.

**Could (v3):**
- **C1 — Channels 7–9 at depth** (probate / divorce / foreclosure), nationwide bulk-roll ingestion,
  graph visualization, automated transfer alerts.

**Won't (this feature):**
- **W1 — Paid APIs / data brokers** (ATTOM, CoreLogic, BatchData, TLO/IDI, Middesk, etc.).
- **W2 — FinCEN BOI dependence** (non-public; March 2025 interim final rule exempted ~all US domestic
  entities). Flag only.
- **W3 — GLBA-violating pretexting** to obtain financial info (hard-blocked).
- **W4 — Legal advice / 50-state PI/collector/data-broker licensing analysis** (out of scope; flagged).
- **W5 — True AVMs / current payoffs** (require paid sources; stated as a limitation, never fabricated).

### 4.2 APIs, Data & States

- **External free sources (no auth / public no-login):** county/state assessor portals; recorder
  grantor-grantee indexes; **ArcGIS REST** parcel layers (query by `OWNER` or `MAIL_ADDR LIKE`); FL
  statewide cadastral layer; Secretary-of-State business registries; OpenCorporates; free people-search
  (ThatsThem / TruePeopleSearch / FastPeopleSearch — leads only); (v2) PACER ≤$30/qtr-free + RECAP.
- **State surface (graph-expansion loop):** `Worklist(seeds)` → per-round fan-out (isolated agents) →
  `findings.md` per agent → between-rounds synthesizer → next worklist → stop when no new high-confidence
  nodes. Hop counter + hub stop-list held by the synthesizer.
- **Internal data:** entity graph (temporal/provenance edges), parcel records (APN-keyed), confidence
  records, review flags, equity rollup, per-run compliance record, JSON cache with TTLs.
- **States of a run:** `COMPLIANCE_BLOCKED` (gate not satisfied) → `NORMALIZED` → `IDENTITY_RESOLVED` →
  `EXPANDING` (loop) → `DEDUPED` → `SCORED` → `ROLLED_UP` → `REPORTED`. Cache wraps every lookup.

### 4.3 Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)

- **NFR-Compliance (hard):** the compliance gate is **blocking**; nothing runs until the
  permissible-purpose record exists. GLBA anti-pretexting is a hard block.
- **NFR-Provenance:** every edge and every parcel attribution carries source + source_url +
  date_first_seen / date_last_verified; per-datum provenance throughout. No figure without a source.
- **NFR-Hedged-language (hard):** output says "likely controlled by," "possible ownership connection via
  mailing address." Reserve "owns" only where a title record directly supports it. Never "definitely owns"
  otherwise.
- **NFR-Precision:** hub-guard + hop-limit + inverse-frequency weighting must prevent combinatorial
  blow-up; **every prune logged** so coverage stays honest.
- **NFR-Corroboration:** "Verified" tier requires **2+ independent isolated agents/channels**; isolation
  enforced so corroboration is genuine.
- **NFR-Determinism (scripts):** normalize / score / dedup / rollup are pure stdlib-only Python, unit-tested,
  deterministic given identical inputs.
- **NFR-Stdlib-only / no-infra:** Python standard library only; no Neo4j / ES / Postgres / billing.
- **NFR-Auditability:** full audit trail per session (rounds, agents, synthesis, pruned nodes).
- **NFR-Resilience:** cache absorbs rate limits + 403 blocks; freshness TTLs make re-runs cheap.
- **NFR-Subscription-only (OKOA standing rule, Assumption):** model work via main-thread Read / `Task()`
  sub-agents; never `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / separate API billing.

## Prioritization & Scope Cut

- **v1 (MVP) ships M1–M14.** Channels 1–4 + recorder full; embedded hub-guarded swarm; deterministic
  scripts + tests; Markdown report + audit trail + cache.
- **Deferred to v2:** channels 5–6, concealment-piercing depth, loan-doc render, `/schedule` monitoring.
- **Deferred to v3:** channels 7–9 at depth, bulk-roll ingestion, graph viz, transfer alerts.
- **Scope-cut rationale:** the highest-yield free channel is the **recorder grantor-grantee index**; v1
  must nail channels 1–4 + recorder + the hub-guarded graph + scoring before adding lien/bankruptcy/court
  depth. PLAN.md Decision D4 (channels 1–4 + recorder full; 5–9 phased) is adopted.

## Metrics & Analytics

> Protocol 0.5. Formulas defined here; computation happens later. Instrumentation logged to
> `.acos/metrics/agent-completions.log` (ACOS already logs agent_type/agent_id) + a feature-local
> `AGENT-METRICS.md`.

- **Production:** Story Points Delivered (SPD, qualitative); Quality-Adjusted Productivity
  `QAP = (Delivered_Value * Quality_Score) / (1 + Rejection_Count)`.
- **Efficiency:** Token Efficiency Ratio (TER) = artifacts per 1K tokens; volume per unit cost (if cost
  data exists).
- **Universal Agent Performance Score:** `UAPS = 0.3*Quality + 0.4*Efficiency + 0.3*CostEffectiveness`.
- **Domain quality signals (product-level):** channel-coverage (counties/channels hit vs. attempted);
  corroboration rate (% parcels with ≥2 independent sources); hub-prune count (precision health);
  false-positive rate at 75/50 cutoffs (from dry-run review); freshness-within-TTL %; compliance-record
  completeness (must be 100%); hedged-language conformance.

## UX & Content

- **Invocation:** explicit only (`disable-model-invocation: true`, `user-invocable: true`) — skip tracing
  carries compliance weight.
- **Compliance header** is the first thing in the report (permissible purpose, debt classification,
  statute mapping, "asset location / debt recovery — NOT for eligibility").
- **Report body (v1):** High-confidence tier → Candidate tier → per parcel `{APN, county/state, situs,
  owner-of-record, mailing, matched-through evidence chain, confidence score + signals, per-record
  freshness, source URLs}` → estimated portfolio value / debt / equity → "Coverage & limits" footer
  (counties searched, hops reached, hubs pruned) → manual-review flags.
- **Language:** hedged throughout (NFR-Hedged-language). Every estimated figure labeled "estimated."
- **v2 render:** institutional memo via `acos-loan-doc-generator-with-visual-verification` (OKOA design
  system, screenshot-verified).

## Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation | Slice |
|---|---|---|
| No free national owner search; county fragmentation | 9-channel union + owner-search-by-state routing matrix | slice-06/07 |
| Name-blocked states (CA/NJ/Cook) | Recorder grantor-grantee index workaround | slice-07 |
| Hub registered agent / shared address → N² false links | Hub stop-list + dynamic detection (≥25) + hop limit (2) + inverse-frequency weighting; log every prune | slice-05 |
| Concealment (trusts/nominees/series LLC) | Channel-9 piercing (mortgage signatories, guaranty, UCC debtor, tax-bill mailing) | v2 slice (flagged in v1) |
| Common-name false positives | ≥2 anchors required; −30 scoring penalty; review flag | slice-03/08 |
| Compliance / legal exposure (DPPA/FCRA/FDCPA/GLBA) | Blocking compliance gate + per-run permissible-purpose record; GLBA hard block | slice-01 |
| Portals 403-block / rate-limit | Cache + freshness TTLs; public no-login pages only; respect robots/rate limits | slice-02 |
| People-search noise | Leads only; corroborate against a primary record before scoring | slice-03 |
| Silent conflict harmonization | Synthesizer **preserves** conflicts as manual-review flags (never harmonize) | slice-06 |
| Equity figures mistaken for AVM | Every figure labeled "estimated"; "no mortgage data found" flag; limits footer | slice-10 |

## Appendix

- **9 discovery channels:** (1) assessor owner-name; (2) recorder grantor-grantee index *(highest-yield)*;
  (3) mailing-address pivot; (4) entity graph (SoS + OpenCorporates); (5) lien/judgment indexes (+UCC
  fixtures); (6) bankruptcy Schedule A/B + SOFA; (7) court records (divorce/probate/foreclosure);
  (8) people-search (leads only); (9) concealment-specific piercing.
- **Owner-search capability by jurisdiction:** statewide = MD, MA, MT; friendly = FL, TX, AZ, NV;
  name-blocked = CA (§7928.205), Cook County IL, NJ (Daniel's Law). Detail in
  `references/owner-search-by-state.md`.
- **Scoring rubric (PLAN.md §7):** +40 owner-of-record exact / +25 tax-mailing match / +25 manager-member-
  officer / +20 shared phone-email / +10 spouse-associate / +10 per independent corroborating channel
  (cap +20) / −40 registered-agent-only / −30 common-name-only / −20 hub-virtual-office mailing / −10
  inactive-dissolved / −10 conflicting owner names / cap ≤40 if the only link runs through a hub.
- **Tiers:** ≥75 high (actionable) · 50–74 candidate (review) · <50 weak (logged only).
- **Reference files:** `sources.md`, `owner-search-by-state.md`, `hub_agents.txt`, `review-flags.md`,
  `compliance.md`.
- **Scripts (stdlib):** normalize, score, dedup, arcgis_query, graph, swarm_dispatch, synthesize_round,
  rollup, cache.

## PRD Summary (One-Page Digest)

- **What:** a user-invoked, compliance-gated, free-sources-only skill that finds all US real property a
  named person or entity **likely owns or controls**, nationwide, for skip-tracing / collections.
- **Why:** no free national owner search exists; sophisticated actors conceal title; paid brokers are
  off-limits and carry FCRA/data-broker exposure.
- **How (the bet):** maximize independent **discovery channels** (9) + entity-graph pivots, union the
  results, corroborate via **blind isolated swarm agents**, control precision with a **hub-guard + hop
  limit**, score into **confidence tiers**, estimate equity from free data, and gate everything behind a
  **blocking compliance check** with a full audit trail and hedged language.
- **v1 scope:** compliance gate → normalize → identity → entity graph (hub-guarded) → channels 1–4 +
  recorder → embedded swarm + synthesizer → dedup → scoring → equity rollup → Markdown report + audit
  trail → cache + tests. **v2:** channels 5–6, piercing, loan-doc render, monitoring. **v3:** channels 7–9
  depth, bulk-roll, viz, alerts.
- **Demos:** D0 diagnostics+ADR · D1 compliant thin slice · D2 hub-guarded discovery+graph · D3 ranked
  dossier.
- **Hard rules:** free sources only · blocking compliance gate · hedged language · per-datum provenance ·
  Verified = 2+ independent sources · stdlib-only · log every prune · never fabricate equity.
